summary: All 3 tests in the Product Overview suite failed. Failures are due to missing elements and timeouts indicating possible selector mismatches or application issues.
rootCause: The tests failed because the expected elements identified by data-testid selectors were not found or visible within the timeout period, suggesting that the selectors do not match the current application DOM or the application did not render the elements as expected.

failedTests.testName: TC-001 - Verify grid of product cards is displayed on home page
failedTests.errorMessage: expect(locator('[data-testid="product-grid"]')).toBeVisible() failed: element(s) not found within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector '[data-testid="product-grid"]' did not match any element on the page, possibly due to changes in the application UI or incorrect selector in the test.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the element with data-testid 'product-grid' exists on the home page and update the selector if the application UI has changed.

failedTests.testName: TC-002 - Verify product card details are displayed
failedTests.likelyCause: No product cards were found on the page, likely because the selector for product cards is incorrect or the product grid did not render due to application issues.
failedTests.recommendation: Check if the product cards are rendered on the page and confirm the selector used to locate product cards is correct and up to date.

failedTests.testName: TC-003 - Verify navigation to product detail page from product card
failedTests.errorMessage: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded while waiting for locator('[data-testid="product-card"]').first().locator('[data-testid="product-name"]').innerText()
failedTests.likelyCause: The test timed out waiting for the product name element inside the first product card, indicating the element was not found or the page did not load as expected.
failedTests.recommendation: Investigate if the product cards and product name elements are present and visible. Confirm selectors are correct and the application is loading the page properly within the timeout.

recommendations: Verify and update selectors used in tests to match the current application DOM structure.
Confirm that the application is rendering the product grid and product cards correctly in the test environment.
Check for any recent UI changes that might have affected element identifiers or visibility.
Consider increasing timeout values if the application is slow to load elements.
Review test environment stability to rule out environment-related delays or failures.
releaseImpact: High - All critical product overview tests failed, blocking validation of product listing and navigation features.
